paragraphs.zh: 13. paragraphs.en: 13. A process for preparing a 3-bromomethylbenzoic acid of formula II [drawing, formula (II)] which comprises brominating a 3-methylbenzoic acid of formula I [drawing, formula (I)] with elemental bromine and irradiation with a photolamp, where, in formulae I and II R1 is fluorine, chlorine or bromine, and R2 is (C1-C4)alkyl.
paragraphs.notes: One claim whose running text is interrupted twice by a drawn formula; the two interruptions are marked inline in brackets and the drawings themselves are recorded in the drawings array. R1 and R2 print with the 1 and 2 as superscripts; C1 and C4 print with the 1 and 4 as subscripts. The formula labels (II) and (I) print flush to the right margin, above their respective drawings. The alkyl range in this claim was checked at 5x and prints as (C1-C4)alkyl, with a plain hyphen between the two.

paragraphs.zh: 19. A compound of formula II [drawing, formula (II)] wherein R1 is fluorine, chlorine or bromine, and R2 is (C1-C4)alkyl, excluding 3-bromomethyl-2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-benzoic acid.
paragraphs.en: 19. A compound of formula II [drawing, formula (II)] wherein R1 is fluorine, chlorine or bromine, and R2 is (C1-C4)alkyl, excluding 3-bromomethyl-2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-benzoic acid.
paragraphs.notes: A compound claim, not a process claim. The excluded compound is printed hyphenated across a line break as '3-bromomethyl-2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-' / 'benzoic acid'; the hyphen before 'benzoic' sits exactly at the line break, so it cannot be told from the pixels whether it is part of the name or a line-break hyphen. Transcribed here with the hyphen retained, as printed. R1 and R2 superscripted, C1 and C4 subscripted. Alkyl range checked at 5x: (C1-C4)alkyl.

paragraphs.zh: 20. The compound as claimed in claim 19, wherein R1 is chlorine, and R2 is (C2)alkyl.
paragraphs.en: 20. The compound as claimed in claim 19, wherein R1 is chlorine, and R2 is (C2)alkyl.
paragraphs.notes: The alkyl designation was the single most damaged token in the text layer and was therefore checked at 10x magnification. It prints as an opening parenthesis, a capital C, a clearly formed subscript numeral 2, a closing parenthesis, then 'alkyl.'. It is (C2)alkyl, not (C1)alkyl and not a range. The glyph is a 2: it has the flat horizontal base stroke and the open upper bowl of a 2, and is the same glyph as the subscript 2 in the R2 label on the same line. Recorded as printed; no correction applied.
End-of-claims marker, five asterisks centred in the right column below claim 20. Nothing is printed on the page after this; the lower third of the page is blank.

discrepancies.what: Claim 20 narrows R2 to a single carbon count using a notation the rest of the page does not use.
discrepancies.drawing_says: The formula (II) drawing carries only the variable label SO2R2 and says nothing about the size of R2.
discrepancies.text_says: Claim 19 defines R2 as (C1-C4)alkyl, while dependent claim 20 writes it as (C2)alkyl, a one-member range written as a bare (C2) rather than as (C2-C2)alkyl or as 'ethyl'. The value is inside the parent range, so this is a narrowing and not a contradiction, but the notation is unusual and is the token most likely to be mis-transcribed downstream.

discrepancies.what: The compound excluded by claim 19 is the R1 = chlorine, R2 = methyl member, and claim 20 then claims R1 = chlorine with R2 = (C2)alkyl.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Not addressable from the drawing; both R1 and R2 are open variables.
discrepancies.text_says: Claim 19 excludes 3-bromomethyl-2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-benzoic acid, i.e. the R2 = methyl member. Claim 20 keeps R1 = chlorine but sets R2 = (C2)alkyl, which sits outside the disclaimer. Recording this as an observed relation between two printed statements, not as a defect.

discrepancies.what: Parallel claim series 8-12 and 14-18 are not exact mirrors.
discrepancies.text_says: Claim 10 names acetonitrile as the second solvent, claim 16 names methylene chloride. Both were magnified and both readings are certain, so the asymmetry is in the printed document, not in the reading.
